test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Convert to indirect speech:She said, “I had completed the report.”

options.text: She said she completed the report.
She said she has completed the report.
She said that she had completed the report.
She said she had been completing the report.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she had completed the report.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" is followed by "that" when converting to indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun "I" changes to "she" to match the subject.
 
• The past perfect tense ("had completed") remains unchanged in indirect speech as the reporting verb is in the past.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• Sentence structure is adjusted to a statement, not a direct quote.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *She said that she had completed the report.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** She said she completed the report. 

 
 
• Incorrect tense; does not convey the past perfect meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** She said she has completed the report. 
 
 
• Incorrect tense; present perfect is not appropriate here.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** She said she had been completing the report. 
 
 
• Incorrect tense; this is past perfect continuous and changes the meaning.
